text:
Priya: FYI — Sales flagged a new contract ask from FinEdge: 99.99% monthly uptime + p95 inference latency <=150ms for hosted API, plus 24/7 premium support. Need product triage.
Kevin: pinging infra + runtime teams. Is 150ms p95 realistic on our multi-tenant hosted pool?
Anna: @Kevin probably not for long-tail sequence lengths on shared capacity. Dedicated/reserved pools look required.
Sam: For Dedicated we can hit ~150ms p95 if we standardize on a quantized variant and enable aggressive KV prefix caching; need a benchmark with their token distribution.
Priya: Sales also asked for an escalation flow if SLA is breached — who owns alerts, credits calc, and customer comms.
OpsBot: [deploy] Canary rollout 0.63 -> prod started by @Kevin at 2024-06-14T10:11:05Z
Kevin: Proposed triage & routing checklist: 1) Product-level approval for SLA delta 2) SRE defines monitoring + alert thresholds 3) Runtime implements per-tenant routing + fallback policies 4) Support runbook + escalation matrix 5) Legal SLA wording.
Anna: Launch acceptance criteria (draft): - p95 latency <=150ms on prod-like load for dedicated config - automated fallback to compatible lower-cost model with <5% degradation in quality - alerting + paging validated end-to-end - billing/credit calculation implemented.
Sam: Important scope items for eng/runtime: model pinning per-route, tenant-aware routing, emergency fallback chain, per-request cost telemetry.
Priya: Draft SLA clause for legal review:
```
Redwood guarantees 99.99% monthly uptime for the Redwood Hosted Inference API for FinEdge. If monthly uptime falls below the SLA, customer will be eligible for service credits according to the schedule in the contract. Latency commitments are provided for Dedicated deployments only.
```
Kevin: Given variance on public shared pools, +1 to committing latency SLOs only for Dedicated. We can promise uptime for hosted but latency for Dedicated.
Anna: Sales should present an option matrix: Hosted (uptime SLA only) vs Dedicated (uptime + latency SLOs + premium support). I'll add product stories for both tracks.
Sam: Tentative estimates and dependencies: benchmark harness (2w), runtime: route-by-tenant & fallback (3w), billing/credits changes (1w), support runbook + pager setup (1w).
Priya: Owners: Benchmarks -> Sam; Runtime routing -> Kevin; Billing/credits -> Anna; Runbook/escalation -> Priya; Legal SLA draft -> Priya to shepherd with Legal.
Support-Sally: Support can operate the escalation matrix once we have on-call names and runbook steps. We'll need contact points for FinEdge (primary + escalation).
Priya: Final launch acceptance (short): 1) Benchmarks on prod-like infra meet p95 target for Dedicated path 2) Canary plan + automated rollback present 3) Support + SRE on-call rota validated 4) Contract language approved.
Kevin: Fallback policy sketch: prefer Dedicated reserved pool -> compatible quantized model -> region fallback -> queued requests with soft-limits. I'll write a short diagram in a follow-up message.
Anna: Note pricing implications: Dedicated + premium support requires clear bands; finance will need an estimate for sales to include in quote.
Priya: Next actions: I'll open a product intake ticket with the above scope and acceptance criteria, tag as priority: enterprise-sla, and link this thread. Sales to confirm FinEdge token length distribution and QPS by EOD Friday.
Sam: Starting benchmark job today, will post initial numbers in this thread.
Priya: :thumbsup:
